verdict.rationale: Alloy markets agentic automation for KYC/KYB, AML and fraud checks, so a buyer could fairly ask whether its agents can use external MCP servers. The axis applies, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or connecting outside tool servers. Its webhooks, Events API, workflows, OpenAPI document and llms.txt are integration or documentation features, not an MCP-client capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
